answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a crystal-clear public registry before it can transact, with reputation earned only through verified completed work. A new identity starts like a grain of sand on a dune: it can move only tiny amounts until peers attest its history. The stake is the nectar attackers crave to steal, but creating thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of stakes, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught cheating, so a Sybil flood costs far more than it can earn.
